facts.label: official
facts.quote: Under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme, all resident individuals, including minors, are allowed to freely remit up to USD 2,50,000 per financial year (April – March) for any permissible current or capital account transaction or a combination of both.
facts.text: Under the Reserve Bank of India's Liberalised Remittance Scheme, resident individuals are permitted to freely remit up to 250,000 USD per financial year for purposes including overseas studies.

facts.label: official
facts.text: Outward remittances from India under the Liberalised Remittance Scheme specifically for studies abroad totaled 2,309.74 million USD during financial year 2025-26.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: However, for loans of higher amounts, the margin requirement may be 5% for inland studies and 15% for studies abroad.
facts.text: Under the Indian Banks' Association Model Educational Loan Scheme circulated by the Reserve Bank of India, education loans above 4 lakh INR for overseas studies mandate a borrower margin of 15 percent.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: RBI issued circular RPCD.SME&NFS.BC.No.69/06.12.05/2009-10 dated April 12, 2010, on Collateral Free Loans - Educational Loan Scheme, making it mandatory that banks must not obtain collateral security in the case of education loans upto ₹4 lakh.
facts.text: Reserve Bank of India guidelines make it mandatory for scheduled commercial banks to grant education loans up to 4 lakh INR without demanding collateral security.

facts.label: official
facts.text: The IBA Model Education Loan Scheme provides students with a maximum loan repayment period of 15 years after the completion of studies and the moratorium period.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Repayment Holiday/ Moratorium: Course period plus 6 months.
facts.text: For overseas education loans under State Bank of India's Global Ed-Vantage Scheme, the repayment moratorium is structured as the course duration plus 6 months.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: The Loans are sanctioned as Term Loans and are to be repaid in EMIs over a maximum repayment term of 15 years (180 EMIs) for Student, Scholar, PM-Vidyalaxmi and Global Ed-vantage Education Loans.
facts.text: Education loans under State Bank of India's overseas schemes are structured as term loans repayable in equated monthly instalments across a maximum term of 180 EMIs.
